faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about EB2 NIW and our AI-driven services.
faq.q1.question: What is EB2 NIW?
faq.q1.answer1: The EB2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) is an employment-based immigration category, inviting exceptional professionals to pursue a U.S. green card without the need for employer sponsorship, if it aligns with U.S. interests.
faq.q1.link_text: For Verification: Please click here to verify credentials with USCIS.
faq.q2.question: How does AI refine the application journey?
faq.q2.answer: Our AI tools thoroughly analyze datasets of successful applications, provide alerts for potential challenges, and fortify application strengths — always under the watchful eye of Judge Alsamhan's expertise.
